name: compact-code-viewer
description: A compact ChatGPT MCP App widget for complete, copyable code without giant chat messages.

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck:worker
scripts.lint: eslint server shared web worker tests scripts
scripts.worker:dev: npm run build:web && wrangler dev --local --log-level error --show-interactive-dev-session=false
scripts.worker:dry-run:production: npm run build:web && npm run scan:worker-production-config && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .public-release-build --config wrangler.production.jsonc
scripts.worker:deploy:bootstrap: npm run build:web && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.deploy.jsonc
scripts.worker:deploy:production: npm run build:web && npm run scan:worker-production-config && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.production.jsonc
